name: Repulsion Field
summary: It keeps an opposing static card off the field for as long as it holds.

face.name: Repulsion Field

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Send an opposing static card to the Abyss. As long as this card remains in play, that static card stays in the Abyss. When this card leaves play, that static card returns to play.

face.flavor: Space refuses to hold it. For now.
